items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I did 'Summer Winds' with Wayne Newton

ctx.x: I also recorded "Earth Angel" with a group called the Penguins, which was a big hit. I did "Summer Winds" with Wayne Newton; I recorded a song that -- now here's a story for you -- I did the "Colonel Bogie's March" with Mitch Miller, which was a big hit. They wanted a field drum sound -- I was always figuring out sounds and things, and so they wanted a field drum sound, but they didn't have a field drum there, and I don't know where I got the idea from, but it dawned on me, and I said to Jimmy Carroll, who was an…
